scope: Proposition 6.2 (Transport to deformation coefficients) of the manuscript “A rational obstruction to strong chromatic splitting at height three” (preprints/A-rational-obstruction-to-strong-chromatic-splitting-at-height-three-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 318 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 6d0bd23f35dc42a1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 33. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the nonzero scalar a ∈ Q× p of Theorem 5.3, one has cW 3 = a cW 2 in H3 (G, W(L̂))[1/p], (6.6) and hence c3 = a c2 in H3 (G, π0B̂□ )[1/p]. (6.7) Under (3.4), the preimage of c2 in H3 (H, π0E□ 2 )[1/p] is obtained by inflating eP2 and then including constants.
